text: Wan2GP — free open-source AI video studio. Text-to-video, image-to-video. Runs on 6GB VRAM (even RTX 10 series/laptops). Built-in models: Wan 2.2, LTX-2, Hunyuan Video, Flux. LoRA support, mask editor, prompt enhancer. Browser UI with queue system. No upload, no watermark.
